capability: Matrix Layer Groups use Inspector-inspired container wraps: softly tinted bodies, colored header accents and rounded lower returns. The entire child card, including its selection/hover contour, is inset inside ancestor wraps; decoration paints below those cards. Group-owned custom/reset colors, disabled emphasis, nesting, offscreen ancestors, clipping, collapse and reparent/reorder remain supported.
ownership: MapGyver's cached view index builds typed visible Group intervals and transfers only Groups represented in a bounded viewport plus their ancestors. Rust generates MatrixGroupSpan and MatrixViewportSnapshot.row_groups. GroupRails projects those intervals through the existing mixed-height viewport math and reads indexed Golden metadata; it adds no authored setting, descendant scan, preview lease or pointer hit target.

earlier_attempts: The first design reserved padding for controls but still crossed full-width selection contours. The user rejected its appearance; the final revision insets the actual row card, paints Inspector-inspired tinted wraps below it and adds selected-child separation checks. Earlier scrolling ran before new rows were installed; the fixture now waits for the90-row declaration and actual scroll range. Decorations also moved outside the scrollport and viewport origins clamp after content shrinks. Missing JSDoc types in the prior compact-Group browser helper were fixed before acceptance. Two normal builds encountered FFmpeg DLL locks from user development windows; each final build succeeded after the user saved/closed the window. Only the final redesigned bundle receives current acceptance credit.
